title: A framework for separating dephasing from decoherence in matter-wave Bell interferometers
summary: Matter-wave Bell interferometers provide a sensitive probe of mass-dependent decoherence in entangled quantum systems. The degree of entanglement is obtained from the Bell-correlation amplitude of this interferometer. For observing potential mass-dependent decoherence, a reliable interpretation of any observed reduction in the Bell correlation amplitude is required, which depends on three factors: geometric dephasing, environmental decoherence, and technical dilution from source and detection statistics.
